CustomField.description: Skill versioning: for a packaged firm skill (Packaged Skill ID = a firm skill store slug), the fingerprint of the bundle that is live in the skill store, copied from CFO Bot's admin Skill store page after each publish (64 lower-case hex characters; the trigger trims and lower-cases a pasted value). A new value raises Version_Number__c. Blank for text skills. CFO Bot never writes it (its Salesforce user is read-only); its admin page flags a record whose fingerprint doesn't match the live bundle.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Packaged skills only: paste the fingerprint from CFO Bot's Skill store page after publishing a new bundle.
CustomField.label: Bundle Fingerprint
